company.text: Syneos Health is a large biopharmaceutical solutions organization combining clinical (CRO) and commercial services, headquartered in North Carolina. It was taken private in a **$7.1B** deal completed in **September 2023** by Elliott Investment Management, Patient Square Capital and Veritas Capital. **Costa Panagos** became CEO in Oct 2024 (Colin Shannon became Executive Chairman). In 2026 it named **Greg Licholai** CMO (announced May 28, effective Jun 1), expanded **AI partnerships** for commercial performance (May 14) and won a MedTech Breakthrough award for its **PatientGO** app (May 18).
